questions.question: Explain the steps involved in the Scholarly Communication process.
questions.solution_html:
• Scholarly communication is the process of creating and sharing academic knowledge.
  • • It begins with research creation, where new knowledge is generated.
  • • Followed by writing and documentation of research findings.
  • • The work undergoes peer review to ensure quality and originality.
  • • Then it is published in journals, books, or conference proceedings.
  • • Research is disseminated and accessed through libraries, databases, and digital platforms.
  • • Finally, it is cited and preserved for future use
